studies.title: The Catalan Atlas
studies.caption: Abraham Cresques's workshop paints a world map on vellum panels, joining the portolan coasts with Marco Polo's Asia and Mansa Musa holding his gold.
studies.prompt: Close angled view of a fourteenth-century Majorcan illuminators hands painting a map on joined vellum panels; deep blue Mediterranean, red and ochre settlements, one tiny seated West African ruler with a gold disk, delicate caravan figures inland. Rich but unfinished detail, no readable lettering.
